description: Validate successful LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach procedures for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario configured with only one active UE.
Excellent radio conditions established (LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
End-to-end LTE or 5G NSA setup operational and no connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure test setup as per test configuration and record parameters in test report.
Place UE (real or emulated) at cell center close to radiated eNB/gNB antenna to ensure excellent radio conditions.
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for successful attach procedure (validate attach request and attach complete messages).
Verify UE is attached to the correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, and ARFCN/NR-ARFCN in UE logs or applications.
Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure and wait for successful detach (validate detach request and detach accept messages).
Stop and save test logs for verification.
Repeat the attach-detach cycle 10 times.
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency KPIs in test report.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully 10 consecutive times.
Attach and detach success rates are 100%.
Attach latency values (min, average, max) are within acceptable limits.
UE remains attached to correct cell as per test configuration during attach.
Logs confirm correct signaling message flow as per 3GPP standards.
commandsUsed: Start log capture via system monitoring interface
Power ON UE via test automation interface
Power OFF UE via test automation interface
Retrieve UE logs and signaling messages
Measure latency using timestamped signaling events
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach and detach message validation
KPI calculations for success rates and latency
UE application log verification for cell attachment info

description: Test UE-initiated detach failure handling by simulating detach request rejection or signaling interruption.
preconditions: Single cell LTE or 5G NSA scenario with one active UE under excellent radio conditions.
End-to-end setup operational.
testSteps: Configure test environment and start log capture.
Power ON UE and perform successful attach.
Simulate network failure or reject detach request message during UE-initiated detach procedure (e.g., block detach accept message).
Observe UE behavior and network signaling response.
Attempt to power OFF UE to trigger detach again.
Capture logs and signaling messages.
Repeat at least 3 times to validate behavior consistency.
expectedResults: UE detects detach failure and retries detach procedure or performs recovery as per protocol.
Network handles detach failure gracefully without resource leakage.
Logs show failed detach attempts and recovery signaling.
No deadlocks or hang states in UE or network.
postconditions: UE detached successfully after recovery or test terminated cleanly.
commandsUsed: Intercept or block detach accept signaling message in test environment
Power ON/OFF UE via test interface
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for detach failure and retry signaling
Check UE state transitions in logs
Validate resource release in network logs

description: Validate attach-detach behavior when UE is placed at the boundary of minimum coupling loss defined in Clause 4.6.
preconditions: Test environment supports variable attenuator or fading generator.
Single cell LTE or 5G NSA setup operational.
testSteps: Configure radio conditions to achieve exactly the minimum coupling loss as defined.
Place UE in RF shielded box or appropriate position to maintain this condition.
Start log capture.
Perform 10 iterations of attach followed by detach.
Measure attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency.
Record radio parameters such as RSRP and RSRQ during each iteration.
Stop log capture and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain at 100% despite borderline radio conditions.
Attach latency remains within acceptable limits.
Radio parameters recorded accurately reflect minimum coupling loss.
No unexpected failures or retries.
postconditions: Logs and KPIs recorded for analysis.
commandsUsed: Configure attenuator/fading generator to minimum coupling loss
verificationMethods: Validate signaling message flows for attach and detach

description: Measure attach-detach performance metrics including success rates and latency over 10 consecutive iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell LTE or 5G NSA setup with stable excellent radio conditions.
Test environment able to perform repeated attach-detach cycles automatically.
testSteps: Configure test setup and start detailed logging.
Automate UE power ON for attach and power OFF for detach cycles.
Perform 10 consecutive attach-detach iterations without manual intervention.
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, attach latency (min, average, max).
Capture and analyze radio parameters during test.
Stop logging and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% for all 10 cycles.
Attach latency is consistent and within defined thresholds.
No performance degradation or failures observed during iterations.
postconditions: Test data archived for performance benchmarking.
verificationMethods: Trend analysis of latency over iterations

description: Test attach procedure failure due to incorrect or invalid authentication credentials during LTE or 5G NSA initial attach.
preconditions: Test UE configured with invalid authentication credentials.
Single cell LTE or 5G NSA test environment.
testSteps: Configure test setup and start logging.
Power ON UE to initiate attach.
Observe signaling messages related to authentication and security procedures.
Capture attach failure messages and reasons.
Verify UE behavior upon attach failure (e.g., retry attempts, error reporting).
Power OFF UE.
Repeat test with different invalid credentials to confirm behavior.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails due to authentication failure.
Network rejects attach request with appropriate cause codes.
UE handles failure as per specification (e.g., retry, notify user).
No unauthorized access granted.
Logs contain detailed authentication failure messages.
postconditions: UE remains detached after failed attach attempts.
verificationMethods: Review cause codes in network messages

description: Validate correct MN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure with proper signaling flows and resource release.
preconditions: 5G NSA EN-DC setup with MN and SN nodes active.
UE attached with secondary node added successfully.
testSteps: Start detailed log capture on MN, SN, and UE sides.
Initiate MN initiated SN Release by sending SgNB Release Request message from MN.
Verify SN responds with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge.
Check MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE instructing SCG release.
Validate SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages to MN.
Confirm UE Context Release message reception at SN.
Observe SN releasing radio and C-plane resources.
Verify data forwarding coordination if applicable.
Stop log capture and save logs.
expectedResults: All signaling messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
UE releases SCG configuration successfully.
SN releases resources without errors.
Data forwarding coordinated to minimize service gaps.
No unexpected message rejections or failures.
Logs reflect correct sequence and successful completion.
postconditions: SN context released and UE remains attached only to MN.
commandsUsed: Trigger MN initiated SgNB Release Request via management interface
verificationMethods: Cross-check signaling message order and contents
Validate resource release events in SN logs
Confirm UE SCG release via RRC messages

description: Validate SN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure with proper signaling and coordination with MN and UE.
preconditions: 5G NSA EN-DC setup with MN and SN nodes active.
UE attached with secondary node added successfully.
testSteps: Start multi-node log capturing.
Simulate SN initiating SN Release by sending SgNB Release Required message to MN.
Verify MN responds with SgNB Release Confirm message including data forwarding addresses if applicable.
Check MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE instructing SCG release.
Monitor SN sending SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages to MN.
Confirm UE Context Release message reception at SN.
Observe SN releasing radio and control plane resources.
Stop log capture and save logs.
expectedResults: Signaling messages exchanged correctly per 3GPP specifications.
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed.
Data forwarding coordinated effectively.
No message rejections or errors.
SN releases resources successfully.
postconditions: UE attached only to MN after SN release.
commandsUsed: Trigger SN initiated SgNB Release Required via SN interface
Start/stop log capture on MN, SN, UE
verificationMethods: Check resource release in SN logs

description: Test system behavior when UE sends attach requests with incorrect or corrupted parameters.
preconditions: Single cell LTE or 5G NSA setup.
Capability to manipulate UE attach request messages.
testSteps: Start log capture in network and UE sides.
Power ON UE and modify attach request messages to include invalid PCI, ARFCN, or identifiers.
Send attach request and observe network response.
Capture any error messages or reject causes.
Verify UE reaction to attach rejection.
Repeat for multiple invalid parameter variations.
expectedResults: Network rejects attach requests with invalid parameters with appropriate cause codes.
UE does not attach to incorrect or unauthorized cells.
No system crashes or undefined behavior occurs.
Error handling and messaging is per specification.
postconditions: UE remains detached or retries with corrected parameters.
commandsUsed: Modify attach request message parameters in UE test interface
verificationMethods: Analyze reject cause codes in network logs
Check UE state and retry behavior
Verify no resource leaks or failures

description: Measure attach latency variation when UE is subjected to varying radio conditions from excellent to borderline.
preconditions: Test setup with variable attenuator or fading generator.
Single cell LTE or 5G NSA setup.
testSteps: Configure radio conditions starting at excellent level (as per Clause 4.6).
Perform attach procedure and measure latency.
Gradually degrade radio conditions towards minimum coupling loss boundary.
At each step, perform attach and measure latency.
Record RSRP/SS-RSRP and attach latency for each condition.
Repeat 10 times per radio condition step.
Analyze latency trends versus radio quality.
expectedResults: Attach latency increases as radio conditions degrade but remains within acceptable limits.
Attach success rate remains high until minimum coupling loss boundary.
No unexpected attach failures under tested conditions.
postconditions: Performance report correlating latency with radio conditions.
verificationMethods: Latency calculation from attach signaling timestamps

description: Verify that unauthorized nodes cannot initiate Secondary Node Release procedure.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN nodes.
Capability to simulate unauthorized node messages.
testSteps: Simulate a node not authorized as MN or SN sending SgNB Release Request or SgNB Release Required messages.
Observe network behavior and message acceptance or rejection.
Capture logs for security-related cause codes or alarms.
Verify UE and network maintain connection integrity.
Repeat test with different unauthorized node identities.
expectedResults: Network rejects unauthorized Secondary Node Release requests.
No disruption to UE connection or resource release.
Security alarms or logs generated for unauthorized attempts.
UE remains attached and operational.

Record KPIs and logs.
Repeat test with Release 16 configurations.
Compare attach success rates, detach success rates, secondary node addition and release procedures.
Analyze any protocol or signaling differences and their impact.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed in both releases.
Signaling messages comply with respective release standards.
No interoperability issues or unexpected failures.
KPIs comparable with expected release-specific performance.
commandsUsed: Configure UE and network release versions
